sdk_call: client.responses.with_raw_response.create(model, instructions, input, reasoning, text.format json_schema strict, max_output_tokens, store=false)
tools_note: no tools parameter is sent: no web search, file search, MCP, code interpreter, computer use or function tools
input_modality: text only (instructions + compact state string); no images, no audio
state_transport: Responses 'input' = byte-identical P1/P2 model input text (P1 preamble + '\n\n' + frozen compact JSON bytes)
instructions_transport: Responses 'instructions' = configs/p3_prompt_v1.txt + decision definitions rendered by src/prompt_builder.py from the frozen P1 decisions_questions_v1.json
probability_source_note: P1 = native Decisions API probability; P2 = native Clef decision probability; P3 = LLM-generated structured estimate (not assumed calibrated)
score_mapping: P3 risk scores are 0-1 with level anchors k/(n_levels-1); converted to the P1 typed-score representation as score*(n_levels-1) so the frozen P1 adapter returns the same 0-1 value
retry_policy: network/timeout errors, HTTP 429, HTTP 5xx only; exponential backoff 1s*2^n + U(0,0.25)s jitter; 4xx never retried

failure_policy.refusal: a refusal output item is not a failure: every question becomes a 'refusal' answer and the frozen P1 refusal path applies (unknown decision, risk midpoint 0.5 flagged, confidence 0.0, human review forced); recorded as refusal
failure_policy.incomplete: status=incomplete (max_output_tokens / content_filter) -> item recorded as FAILED, no result file, no retry
failure_policy.schema_parse_failure: output not valid JSON or not valid against the strict schema -> item recorded as FAILED, no result file, no retry
failure_policy.transport: network / 429 / 5xx after 2 retries -> item recorded as FAILED

adapter.decision: experiments/p1_decisions/src/decision_adapter.py executed from frozen bytes (same thresholds, confidence formula, priority weights, tie-break, human-review rule as P1/P2)
adapter.final: experiments/common_adapter_v2 (frozen) applied to the prediction; raw category preserved in runtime_config

pricing.reasoning_tokens_billing: billed as output tokens (included in output_tokens)
pricing.pricing_source: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6.1-sol (Standard: Input $2, Cached input $0.1, Cache writes $2.5, Output $10 per 1M tokens)
